LESSON: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3: Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the qualities of prophets for character formation
2. apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives
3. appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BELIEF IN PROPHETS 3.3.1 QUALITIES OF PROPHETS
Study Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the qualities of prophets for character formation

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the qualities of prophets for character formation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the qualities of prophets for character formation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the qualities of prophets for character formation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives

What this means
In this part you learn to apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the qualities of prophets for character formation)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets in your own words. (skill: apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the qualities of prophets for character formation.
3. Practise this skill: apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate belief in Allah’s prophets by emulating the qualities of prophets.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can qualities of the prophets be applied in daily life?
2. Why are prophets regarded as role models?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the qualities of prophets for character formation.
5. Be able to: apply values learnt from the qualities of prophets in their daily lives.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
